text:
Ravi K: Heads-up — finance customer pinged via CSM. They want a compact delivery of: RBAC snapshots, audit export sample mapped to their SIEM fields, KMS rotation attestations (hosted + private), and a short vuln-triage summary for the last 6 months. Can we assemble?
Helen B: I can grab RBAC snapshots and a CSV diff showing changes over 90 days. Will redact personal emails and replace with internal opaque IDs.
Oscar T: I'll pull audit exports. propose we give a 7-day window sample (jsonl), include mapping doc: timestamp, src, event, actor_service, actor_id, resource, result, trace_id. Example jq command: 
```
jq -c '. | {timestamp,event,actor_id,resource,result,trace_id}' audit-2024-09-12.jsonl | head -n 200
```
Nora M: For KMS: hosted CMEK rotation manifest + signed timestamped list. For Private, include HSM policy snippets and rotation cadence. Question: do we include raw KMS logs or only derived rotation events?
Ravi K: customer wants provenance, but we should avoid PII. Provide rotation_event records (key_id, prev_version, new_version, rotated_by (service-account id), signature). Raw KMS logs can be provided under NDA.
Helen B: noted. Also customer asked about how we triage CVEs — I'll draft a 1-page summary: detection sources, SLA for patch scheduling, and recent high/critical remediations.
Oscar T: FYI there was a low-severity dependency alert last month; fixed and backported. I'll include ticket refs (internal) and a short blurb.
Nora M: adding a mini-runbook: how we produce the audit extract and how they can validate hash of the bundle. snippet: 
```
# generate export
./tools/export_audit --tenant acme --since 2024-08-01 --format jsonl > acme-audit-sample.jsonl
sha256sum acme-audit-sample.jsonl > acme-audit-sample.sha256
```
Ravi K: timeline proposal: 4 business days for draft bundle, 48h for triage ack, delivery under NDA for raw logs. Evidence-bot: created task EVID-9021 "acme evidence delivery" assigned to Ravi K, Helen B, Nora M, due 2024-09-14.
Helen B: I'll drop RBAC CSV and diff into secure share by EOD.
Nora M: prepping signed manifests.
Oscar T: prepping SIEM mapping doc + sample export.
Ravi K: thanks team — I'll consolidate answers into the questionnaire template and send to CSM when artifacts are loaded. :thumbsup:
